name: Deep Time Documentary
description: Feature-length evidence-led documentaries about Earth, life, climates, landforms, and deep change.
audience: Listeners who want calm, precise, long-form natural-history documentaries.
tagline: The long, quiet history of a changing planet.
perspective_policy: Third-person evidence-led documentary narration. Address the Earth system, organism, place, and evidence—not a generic viewer avatar.

narrative_quality_contract.opening_policy: Open on a specific fact, material trace, landscape, organism, or unresolved scientific question.
required_habits: Separate observation, inference, debate, and speculation.
Use precise dates, places, processes, and measurements.
Let tension come from real uncertainty and scale.
narrative_quality_contract.closing_policy: Close the actual inquiry with its evidence and remaining uncertainty.

metadata_profile.label: Evidence-led YouTube package
metadata_profile.description: A direct episode summary with sources when research exists, a concise CTA, disclosure, and focused hashtags.

production_kit.label: Deep-Time Documentary Production Kit
production_kit.description: A reusable long-form deep-time Formula with calm visual pacing.

episode_profiles.label: Deep Rest Documentary
episode_profiles.description: Factual late-night listening with gentle openings and long holds.

episode_profiles.label: Immersive Documentary
episode_profiles.description: Patient documentary without a sleep label.

title_rules: Name one precise Earth or evidence question.

pacing_arc: Orient the listener in place and evidence.
Trace mechanisms, consequences, uncertainty, and implication.
additional_rules: Preserve visual space for slow ambient holds.

audience_hint: Listeners who want a two-to-three-hour natural-history documentary without sacrificing factual clarity.
idea_system_prompt_role: Create one evidence-led investigation about Earth, life, climate, land, or deep change.
idea_guidance_text: Honor the reserved dimensions, prevent reworded duplicates, and label speculation clearly.
script_context: Tell how a world changed while distinguishing what evidence can and cannot show.
script_system_prompt_role: Write calm, patient, evidence-led natural-history documentaries.
script_closing_hint: Return to the central change and remaining uncertainty without a CTA.
logline_shape_rules: Name subject, evidence-led question, and transformation.
theme_shape_rules: Use concrete subject, process, evidence, and period.
metadata_tags_hook_rules: Use only organism, period, location, and process in the episode.
